===Levels 1–99: Rooftop Agility Courses===
[[File:Mark of grace detail.png|thumb|right|100px|A mark of grace.]]
[[Rooftop Agility Course]]s are slower but straightforward and less attention-intensive alternatives to the faster training methods. While training on one of the rooftop courses, there is a chance of finding a [[mark of grace]]. These can be used to purchase the pieces of the [[graceful outfit]], [[Graceful outfit#Recolouring|recolour]] existing pieces of the graceful outfit, or purchase [[amylase crystal]]s which can be sold for profit. Considering the GE price of amylase crystals, each mark of grace is worth {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Amylase crystal|10}}|c}}.

As rooftop courses are less attention-intensive it allows you to integrate other training methods while navigating the course, such as [[High Level Alchemy]] or [[Fletching training]] using [[Dart]] tips.

Marks of grace despawn after 10 minutes, so it is recommended to pick them up as they appear. However, on the [[Ardougne Rooftop Course]] the marks can only spawn on one tile, which stacks the marks and resets the 10-minute timer. The spawn rate of marks on any rooftop course (excluding the [[Canifis Rooftop Course]]) is reduced to 20% of the normal rate once the player reaches 20 Agility levels higher than the requirement of that rooftop course.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/628223083858362368|date=3 August 2015|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/104544|archivedate=25 May 2020|quote=If your unboosted level is 20 higher than required for the course, the rate is reduced to 20% of its normal rate.}} For example, a player training on the [[Seers' Village Rooftop Course]] will get the reduced rate at level 80.

There are non-rooftop courses that also award marks, either directly like the [[Werewolf Agility Course]] or indirectly via their own currency like the [[Colossal Wyrm Course]]. For a full list of sources of marks and approximate rates refer to [[Mark of grace#Marks_of_grace_per_hour|Marks of grace per hour]].
